name: Banking, Payments & Capital Markets Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for Core Banking, Payment Processing, and Capital Markets, covering KYC onboarding, general ledger posting, funds transfer (ACH/Wire/SWIFT), ISO 20022 clearing, payment chargeback disputes, order management (OMS/EMS), trade matching, FIX protocol, and T+1 trade settlement.
owner: Global Banking & Capital Markets Operations Office

checklists.name: Banking, Payments & Capital Markets Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for KYC onboarding, ISO 20022 payment clearing, pre-trade risk checks, and trade settlement.

items.statement: Customer KYC verification confirms identity documents against sanctions and PEP databases.
Payment messages follow ISO 20022 XML formats (pacs.008, camt.053) for domestic and international wire transfers.
Chargeback dispute workflows capture representment evidence within card scheme deadlines (Visa/Mastercard).
Pre-trade risk engine validates buying power and position limits in sub-millisecond execution windows.
Trade confirmation and allocation messages match counterparty instructions for T+1 settlement.

reviewGates.name: Head of Banking & Trading Operations Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Head of Trading & Banking Operations confirms that KYC onboarding, ISO 20022 payment clearing, and pre-trade risk checks meet financial regulations.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the banking and trading documentation confirm transaction integrity and pre-trade risk enforcement?
